$comment: Hand-written source for the catalog's patterns, layouts and templates. Components are not listed here: their IDs live in artifacts/components/*.meta.json (catalogId). build-catalog.mjs merges both into accura-ui/src/app/catalog/catalog.json. IDs never change and are never reused; a replaced entry keeps its ID with status "deprecated" and a replacedBy.

statuses.draft: Exists in the prototype, not written down as a shared pattern.
statuses.in-review: Documented as the shared pattern, not yet measured in the browser.
statuses.stable: Documented and verified in the browser for Accura.

entries.name: App shell
entries.description: Shared sidebar plus the application header bar that holds the module title, notifications and account. Every module page sits inside it; a page never builds its own sidebar.

entries.name: Record list
entries.description: Listing screen: header title, full-width toolbar with search, filters and Create, the list summary row, the table with row actions, pagination, and the filtered empty state in place of the table.

entries.name: Record detail
entries.description: Detail screen: phase gate stepper across the top, main column of record sections, side rail with the current gate and next action, audit trail in a drawer.
entries.note: Only Documents and Knowledge Hub render RecordDetailLayout (checked 2026-09-28). The Change Control and CAPA detail screens build their own layout.

entries.name: Create and edit form
entries.description: Create or edit screen: centred max-width column, page heading, form sections, one primary action.

entries.name: Settings
entries.description: Settings area: section navigation with lookup tables, user screens and form screens inside the settings shell.

entries.name: Dashboard
entries.description: Home screen: summary cards and the work inbox. The landing page of the product.

entries.name: Phase gate stepper
entries.description: Record progress across its stages, the current gate, and who the record is waiting for.
entries.note: Documented as the master but imported by no module (checked 2026-09-28). Detail screens render Stepper directly.

entries.name: Record section
entries.description: Titled card block on a detail screen, optionally collapsible for locked, read-once content.

entries.name: Electronic signature modal
entries.description: Signs a regulated record: signer identity, meaning, optional reason, attestation. One implementation shared by every module.

entries.name: Audit trail drawer
entries.description: Sheet listing a record's audit entries, latest first: actor, role and time, action, state change pill, signature when taken.

entries.name: State change pill
entries.description: Old value struck through, arrow, new value, in one tinted pill. Direction sets the tone: forward, backward or cancel.

entries.name: List summary
entries.description: Row between toolbar and table: the record count, or how many of how many while filtered, with Clear filters.

entries.name: List empty state
entries.description: Replaces the table when a list is empty. ListEmptySearch when filters matched nothing, ListEmptySet when there is nothing to filter.

entries.name: Table pagination
entries.description: Listing footer with page size and page controls, plus the usePagination hook that keeps the page in range as filters shrink the set.

entries.name: Row click
entries.description: Hook that makes a whole table row open its record while menus and links inside the row keep their own clicks. Behaviour only, nothing to render.

entries.name: Loading
entries.description: One loader per case: app splash, route bar with skeletons, a skeleton and error per widget, a page refresh that dims and locks, a button's loading state, a long-task toast. Shown after 300ms, kept at least 500ms.
entries.note: Not wired into any module yet; the Dashboard demo is the only consumer. The catalog's Loading tab runs the demo with its controls.
